versions.content: Use cases where the reference refinedModuleDef is mandatory The refinedModuleDef reference is mandatory if the Ecuc- ModuleDef with the category VENDOR_SPECIFIC_MODULE_DEFINITION actually refines the EcucModuleDef with the category STANDARD- IZED_MODULE_DEFINITION (e.g. Vendor Specific Module Definition of Com BSW module refines Standardized Module Definition of Com BSW module).
